name: Glyph Loot Filter
description: A compact loot filter that shows gems, potions, scrolls, keys and ammo as colored symbols, labels every rune with its level and the gem it needs to cube up, flags high runes, highlights runeword bases, and color-codes the stats that matter. Based on D2R Simple Loot Filter by Cbraqz and kabobist.
author: levinium

config.name: Toggle All
config.description: Each option edits one of the game's string files.

children.name: Item names
children.description: Gem, potion, scroll, key and ammo symbols; runeword base and charm highlights (item-names.json). Most of the filter lives here.

children.name: Item stats
children.description: Color-codes stats such as resistances, +skills, FCR, FHR and IAS (item-modifiers.json).

children.name: Low quality items and normal gems
children.description: Shrinks Low Quality, Damaged, Cracked and Crude items to a gray dot, and draws the four normal gems that live in this file (item-nameaffixes.json).

children.name: Runes
children.description: Shows each rune's number and the gem needed to cube it up, and flags Lem and higher with a Pick Up line (item-runes.json).
